verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents an official MCP server (rollbar-docs-18, rollbar-probe-3), which lets an external AI assistant query and act on Rollbar data, so natural-language operation is possible through a third-party client. It also offers Resolve, an AI agent that turns a production error into a pull request (rollbar-docs-17), but that is a single task-specific workflow rather than general natural-language control. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface inside the product, documentation of which operations the MCP server exposes (e.g. resolve, assign, mute items), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
